title: DDB Inventory Sync
description: Sends loot, merchant trades (Item Piles or any sheet) and coin changes on mapped actors to their D&D Beyond characters, and a party actor's items to the campaign's party inventory, through your own ddb-proxy.

recommends.reason: Merchants and loot piles; their transfers are what this module sends on.
Character mapping, proxy URL and campaign ID are read from ddb-sync when this module's own are empty.
